predictions.prediction_text: Strong gamma support cluster around 6350–6355 acting as a pin/center — market likely to revert to ~6355 if it moves away intraday. 6370–6375 is a nearby gamma wall providing upside resistance in the last 1.5 hours; breaking it requires a steep call bid (vol pickup).
predictions.expected_result: If SPX drifts ± up to ~20 points from current, expect reversion back to 6350–6355; if SPX approaches 6370–6375 in final 1.5 hours without a large increase in call IV, expect rejection and return to ~6355.

predictions.prediction_text: Downside gamma trough / strong rejection zone at ~6323 that is unlikely to be broken intraday; a break would require realized put skew and strong selling, but longer-dated gamma will brake the fall near 6300–6290.
predictions.expected_result: If SPX tests 6323, expect a bounce back toward ~6355; if 6323 is decisively broken with heavy put realization, price should find additional support and likely stall around 6300–6290.

predictions.prediction_text: Lower sticky gamma concentration and magnet around 6220–6245 acts as a deeper support band only in a significant vol spike / bad-news scenario — otherwise unlikely to be reached intraday.
predictions.expected_result: Absent major negative news and vol surge, SPX should not trade down to 6245–6220 during the session; if it does, expect volatility to catch up and a meaningful mean-reversion bounce afterward.

predictions.prediction_text: Intraday ‘line in the sand’ at ~6361: if spot is magnetized by the 6370 calls or the 6350 gamma, 6361 will act as the intra-session pivot determining short-term direction. Holding above 6382 with strong call bids could enable a move toward 6395.
predictions.expected_result: If SPX holds above 6361 and call IV/flow increases, expect push toward 6370–6395; if SPX fails / is below 6361, expect reversion toward 6350 and potential test of 6323.
